source_description_html:
Whether to replace an aging seat, to rebuild a damaged bike, or because your new acquisition only has a seat cowl cover ; for any of these reasons (or any others), AVDB MOTO offers you this specific rear passenger seat pillion, with the same fastening specs as the OEM one.

No modification needed for its installation, which is very easy! For once : as fast to say as it is to do. The photo displays the rear passenger seat exactly as you will receive it.

Brand new product, made in injection ABS with foam padding and imitation leather cover. This rear passenger seat is indeed of good quality manufacture and finish. Padded yes, but not a comfort model for all that : it will obviously be more comfortable than a seat cowl, but this still is a regular rear seat, almost identical to the one that equipped your motorcycle originally.

This being said, foam paddings tend to harden over time and use (whether OEM or aftermarket for that matter). So if your motorbike has been on the road for few years already and carried more than one passenger over time, the comfort of its rear seat pillion can really become uncomfortable. Sometimes to the point that your passenger (or why not your future conquest) may start hating you! Yes, some will say, "I'm already nice enough to carry him / her around, so if he / she complains about the rear passenger seat comfort, then he / she can buy his / her own motorbike! "

Unfortunately, it is not always possible... And we prefer to avoid tensions at home. However, improving his / her comfort will definitely be a great way to give him / her the taste of riding along with you again !

And finally this goes for you too, dear passengers : you love motorcycle rides, but your partner found the excuse of the seat cowl cover to refuse to carry you around ? Well then, here is the perfect gift to change the game (furthermore at this price)

description: Pre Order Import on Order only • Left footrest bracket. • Right foot-rest bracket. • Pair of left and right footrests and the necessary hardware kit (bolt, springs, screws).
source_description_html:
[des]

Pre Order Import on Order only

Delivery Time 25-30 Days

[/des]

Starting your motorcycling at full power (without preliminaries), rubbing your knee and elbow at every curve you encounter, taking every opportunity to hit a rear wheel or make a stoppy .... all this (and much more) are part of the pleasure of riding but it can sometimes have expensive results.

Indeed a poorly controlled start at full acceleration, a badly negotiated turn, a bad encounter with a careless driver, a badly placed crutch, or a basic accident can have negative consequences for your beauty… These are just a few examples of the many situations in which your motorbike can be harmed, and we hope that whatever you've been through the damages have been limited and did not impact more than your motorcycle (which is already a lot).

Or maybe, and quite simply, your new acquisition was used a little too much and with little care by its previous owner, or did not experience maintenance despite its miles of good and loyal services, and it now deserves a facelift before returning to the road ! Some people like to leave their motorcycle with a vintage look, others cannot stand to see their plastics tarnish, their alloy parts scratched or grated and see this rather as sloppiness that burns their eyes at each ride.

Anyway, we do not doubt it, it is with a heavy heart that you are now seeking new parts or accessories to heal the wounds of your motorcycle, to get it dressed as it deserves or to put it back on its two wheels as soon as possible, all without putting your bank account to the same fate.

Do not worry, AVDB Moto has thought of you as much as of your motorbike and offers you this pair of rear foot-rests brackets, provided with its pair of left and right foot-pegs. A complete kit, specific for the models mentioned above and which will install directly in place of your old ones, without any modification to be made at the assembly.

 
The photos are representative of the kit as you will receive it. It is composed of :

- Left footrest bracket

- Right foot-rest bracket

- Pair of left and right footrests and the necessary hardware kit (bolt, springs, screws)

 

Parts that are not provided in the hardware kit are to be recovered on the original passenger brackets.

The perfect parts’ solution for purists, for those who want to keep their machine the same as when it got out of the factory, with the same specificities as OEM, but with a price much more respectful of one’s budget than from the manufacturer.

name: AVDB Seat Cowl for Triumph Daytona 675/R 2013-17
source_title: AVDB Seat Cowl for Triumph Daytona 675/R 2013-17
description: If you want to keep your rear passenger seat because you often carry someone, you will clearly have no use of a seat cowl. But… Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
If you want to keep your rear passenger seat because you often carry someone, you will clearly have no use of a seat cowl. But there are indeed many good reasons to install a seat cover in place of your passenger seat.

We have heard many of them : “I made a great deal, my new motorcycle is perfect. Only bad point, the horrible rear seat the previous owner left on it. I must change it ASAP.”
 
Or :
“I don’t care about having a passenger seat. When I ride, I ride alone and often on tracks. So let’s lose some extra weight, close it up with a seat cowl and I’m good to go.”

But also :
“Well I can not find any more excuse to avoid carrying my lady around. As a passenger, she is horrible… although she loves riding with me, but still does not want to buy her own motorbike. So Icame to realize swithing my ride into a single-seater might just be the solution. By the way, you wouldn’t be interested in my passenger seat ?”

Although we still never heard this one (yet) :

“I did not buy anything from AVDB Moto this month, and this is the last accessory left I didn’t take for my 2-wheelers. I am loyal and constant with my monthly purchases, and I feel this seat cowl may get useful someday.”

But who knows ! Anyway, you may have understood it but there are many uses for a seat cowl. You asked for more and we have been looking for it.

Quick adaptation, without any modification needed : seat cowl made of Injection ABS plastic and with the same fastenings as your OEM passenger seat. You do not need to make any modification and the installation should take around 10 sec. Simply remove your rear passenger seat and replace it with this seat cowl. Nothing else… Well yes, for the most perfectionists, the handymen or those who want to make sure they will never have to carry a passenger anymore, you can also suppress the rear footpegs and their brackets (also a perfect way to save some weight for the tracks for example). Picture accurately displays the seat cowl as you will receive it.

Our seat cowl’s shape follows and makes you OEM rear fairing thinner, guaranteeing a nice single seater finish, altogether at biker price.
